comparison.objective: Place a parcel in a curbside mailbox, raise its carrier flag, and latch the hanging door.
comparison.physical_skill: Parcel insertion plus manipulation of two separate hinged and detented parts.
comparison.success_condition: Parcel is past the sill, door latched, flag upright, and hands clear without crushing the parcel.
comparison.reason: Mailbox loading and latch/flag operation test no threaded adjustment, coupled screw-and-nut countertorque, or retained motion calibration.
